title: New characterizations of BLO spaces by heat semigroups and applications
summary: In this paper, we give two new characterizations of the bounded lower oscillation (BLO) space by using the Gaussian heat semigroup. Using these characterizations, we prove the boundary lower-envelope estimate of the solutions of the heat equation with BLO boundary data, a Gaussian John-Nirenberg criterion and a quantitative estimates of the BLO-norm. Also, we reprove the BMO-BLO boundedness of the Littlewood-Paley $g$-function by using the semigroup method.
